label: preparing
what: A surprise jubilee gathering for the mayor's forty years of service, in the great hall on day 1 at 18:00, coordinated with a lighting inspection and builder's escort. Freight is organizing bread and lanterns and reportedly seeking builder and innkeeper coordination; the innkeeper's actual involvement remains unconfirmed. The baker has supplied 32 of 200 requested loaves, with ingredients and payment for the remainder unresolved. Secretary knowingly coordinates scheduling and supply inquiries; mayor now knows and has requested logistical checks, without authorizing funds.
